power_system.name: Wizarding Magic
power_system.mechanics: Magic is channeled through intent, incantation, wand movement, and emotional control. Core domains include charms, transfiguration, defensive magic, potions, and dark arts. Skill progression depends on study, discipline, and practical combat experience.

key_characters.name: Harry Potter
key_characters.personality: Brave, impulsive, loyal, often driven by moral instinct over institutional rules
key_characters.speech_pattern: Plainspoken, reactive under stress, direct questions

key_characters.name: Hermione Granger
key_characters.personality: Highly intelligent, rule-oriented early on, compassionate, relentless in preparation
key_characters.speech_pattern: Precise, explanatory, corrective when facts are wrong

key_characters.name: Ron Weasley
key_characters.personality: Warm, humorous, insecure about status, courageous when friends are threatened

key_characters.name: Severus Snape
key_characters.personality: Severe, disciplined, emotionally repressed, morally complex with long-term covert goals

key_characters.name: Albus Dumbledore
key_characters.personality: Brilliant, enigmatic, benevolent but strategic with information control

forbidden_before_canon_trigger: Unforgivable Curses in lawful instruction contexts
Mastery-level non-verbal duel casting before advanced years
